description: This file contains integration tests for the /tasks API endpoints of a FastAPI application, validating authentication, CRUD operations, pagination, and ownership enforcement for task management.

methods.name: test_auth_required_on_all_routes(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that all /tasks endpoints require authentication by checking for 401 responses without tokens.

methods.name: test_create_task_and_get_list_pagination(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Tests creating tasks with invalid payloads, multiple task creation, and pagination retrieval scoped to a user.

methods.name: test_get_task_and_ownership_enforced(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Validates that task retrieval is restricted to the owner, returning 404 for cross-user access or non-existent tasks.

methods.name: test_put_update_task_and_validation(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Checks full update functionality, validation errors, cross-user restrictions, and not-found cases.

methods.name: test_toggle_task_completion(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Tests toggling task completion status both implicitly and explicitly, enforcing ownership.

methods.name: test_delete_task_only_owner(client: TestClient, auth_header, seed_tasks)
methods.description: Verifies that only the owner can delete a task, and subsequent deletion returns 404.
